Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, and forgetting a stove while intoxicated is inadvertent negligence, not a conscious disregard of a known risk.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle consists of the two phases of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction and ejection).

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonding forms an open crystalline lattice, which produces the negative slope of the solid-liquid line.
